name: 蒸汽波
description: 80s 梦幻蒸汽波美学：深紫底 #1A0D2E + 霓粉 #FF6AD5 + 水蓝 #79FFE1 双亮色。H1 霓粉超大 uppercase 10px 字距 + text-shadow 发光、H2 水蓝带下划、blockquote 霓粉柔底 + 水蓝左条、全局 font 等宽混搭。retro future 复古未来。适合 AI 艺术/赛博哲思/亚文化/电子音乐评论。

styles.h1: font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; color: #FF6AD5; text-align: center; line-height: 1.25; margin-top: 40px; margin-bottom: 28px; letter-spacing: 10px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #79FFE1; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 18px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid #79FFE1; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #FF6AD5; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 26px; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h4: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #C4A0E8; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px;
styles.h5: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #79FFE1; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: 1.5px;
styles.h6: font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #8B7BA8; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.p: font-size: 15px; color: #E8DAFB; line-height: 1.85; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.4px;
styles.blockquote: background: rgba(255,106,213,0.10); border-left: 4px solid #79FFE1; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 22px; font-size: 15px; color: #FFCCEE; line-height: 1.8; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 15px; color: #FFCCEE; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 0.5px; background: transparent;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; display: block; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; border: 2px solid #FF6AD5; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #79FFE1; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 34px; margin-bottom: 34px; height: 2px; border: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#FF6AD5 30%,#79FFE1 70%,transparent);
styles.code: background: rgba(121,255,225,0.12); border-radius: 0; font-size: 92%; color: #79FFE1; font-family: 'VT323','SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #0D0620; border: 2px solid #FF6AD5; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #79FFE1; color: #79FFE1; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; background: #FF6AD5; color: #1A0D2E; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #79FFE1; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'VT323','SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 14px; border: 2px solid #FF6AD5;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #1A0D2E; background: #FF6AD5; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 12px;
styles.li: font-size: 15px; color: #E8DAFB; line-height: 1.85; letter-spacing: 0.4px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
